**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the operational friction problem is. Ex. I'm frustrated when trying to model...

A clear and concise description of what mathematical formula, UI module, or pluggable provider you want to see.

**Describe Alternatives You've Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

**Non-Clinical & Open-Source Adherence**
- [ ] This proposal avoids clinical diagnosis or medical recommendations.
- [ ] This proposal does not require mandatory paid cloud SaaS dependencies for core operation.

**Additional Context**
Add any other context, wireframes, or paper citations about the feature request here.
